access.bulk: Kansas regulation expressly prices entity bulk download service after enrollment.
access.api: No official business-entity read API contract was located.
access.search: Official entity search exists separately from the regulated bulk service.

fields.summary: The official fee regulation does not publish the entity file schema, stable identifiers, status dictionary, address roles, sample, counts or checksums.

active_status_semantics: Entity-registry status and biennial-report standing are legal filing evidence, not verified operation; exact included statuses are undocumented for bulk.
statewide_completeness: A bulk service exists, but the public regulation does not establish full statewide scope, excluded entity types or control totals.
address_zip: No official person-free bulk layout establishes organization-controlled address or ZIP/ZIP4 availability.
automation_terms_fees: Enrollment required; entity bulk download is $1,500 per month under the effective regulation. Delivery automation and agreement terms are unresolved.
redistribution: The fee rule does not grant retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication or redistribution rights.
temporal_refresh: Monthly pricing is explicit; file generation cadence, full/delta semantics, deletions, replay and checksums are not documented in reviewed official material.

citations.evidence: Official permanent regulation: enrollment and $1,500 monthly entity bulk-download fee.
Official entity-search route, not evidence of bulk automation permission.

strongest_next_action: Request unsigned enrollment terms, current person-free schema/sample, entity/status/address coverage, stable-key lifecycle, counts, cadence, full/delta/deletion/replay/checksum behavior and explicit reuse rights before enrollment or payment.
